# Taxonomic and functional homogenization in irrigated and non-irrigated fields

## Clear workspace and set directory

```{r setup}
rm(list=ls())
getwd()
setwd("~/GitHub/irrigation/Beta_diversity")
```

# Load packages

```{r}
library(vegan)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

# Import data

```{r}
# 1. Metadata
design <- read.csv("./Homogenization_analysis/Data/Metadata.csv", header = TRUE, row.names = 1)

design.irr <- subset(design, Irrigation == "irrigated")
design.unirr <- subset(design, Irrigation == "non-irrigated")

# 2. Select the same number of samples at random as there are non-irrigated samples.
set.seed(12345)
nonirr.samples <- sample(rownames(design.unirr), size = 23, replace = FALSE)

# 3. Taxonomic Community 
comm <- read.csv("./Homogenization_analysis/Data/RPKM.species.abundance.csv", header = TRUE, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)

# 4. Sample selection
# 46 samples
selected.samples <- c(rownames(design.irr),  nonirr.samples)

stopifnot(all(selected.samples %in% colnames(comm)))

comm.new01 <- comm[ , selected.samples, drop = FALSE]

# Filter low-abundance features
comm.new01 <- comm.new01[rowSums(comm.new01) > 10,  ,  drop = FALSE]

# Samples × features
comm.new <- t(comm.new01)

design.new <- design[rownames(comm.new), , drop = FALSE]

design.new$Irrigation <- factor(design.new$Irrigation, levels = c("non-irrigated", "irrigated"))

stopifnot(all(rowSums(comm.new) > 0))

# 5. Calculate dissimilarity
jac_dist <- vegdist(comm.new,  method = "jaccard",  binary = T) # ignore abundance, consider presence

# 6. Convert to similarity
jac_sim <- 1 - as.matrix(jac_dist)

# 7. Function: within-group similarity
calculate_similarity <- function(sim_matrix, metadata) {
  
  groups <- metadata$Irrigation
  results <- list()
  for (g in levels(groups)) {
    samples <- rownames(metadata)[groups == g]
    submat <- sim_matrix[
      samples,
      samples,
      drop = FALSE
    ]
    
    values <- submat[lower.tri(submat)]
    results[[g]] <- data.frame(
      Irrigation = g,
      Similarity = values
    )
  }
  
  bind_rows(results)
}

# 8. Calculate within-group similarities
jac_data <- calculate_similarity(jac_sim, design.new)

# 9. Summarize
jac_summary <- jac_data %>%
  group_by(Irrigation) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(Similarity),
    SD = sd(Similarity),
    N_pairs = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(jac_summary)


# 10. Relative change in similarity (%)
relative_change <- function(df) {
  irr <- df$Mean[df$Irrigation == "irrigated"]
  unirr <- df$Mean[df$Irrigation == "non-irrigated"]
  (irr - unirr) / unirr * 100
}

relative_change(jac_summary)

```


# Plot taxonomic homogenization

```{r}
colors <- c("irrigated"="#4169B2", "non-irrigated"="#BB2BA0")

range(jac_data$Similarity)
p1 <- ggplot(jac_data, aes(x = Irrigation, y = Similarity, fill = Irrigation)) +
  geom_violin(linewidth= 0.3, size= 0.2, alpha= 0.7, color = "black") +
  geom_boxplot(alpha= 1, width= 0.16, size= 0.8, fill= "white") +
  geom_jitter(size= 1.5, width = 0.12, alpha= 0.2) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Taxonomic similarity", title = "") +
  theme_bw() + scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(colour = "black", size = 16),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "black", size = 16),
        legend.position = "none",
        panel.border = element_rect(color="black", size=1),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) + ylim(0.66, 0.925)

p1
ggsave("./Homogenization_analysis/Output/Taxonomic Homogenization_(jaccard).pdf", p1, width = 4.5, height = 5)


# Statistical test
t.test(Similarity ~ Irrigation, var.equal = F, data = jac_data)   # t= 5.24, p = 2.515e-07***
wilcox.test(Similarity ~ Irrigation, data = jac_data)   # W = 39902, p-value = 1.57e-06***
```


# Functional homogenization

```{r}
# 1. Metadata
design <- read.csv("./Homogenization_analysis/Data/Metadata.csv", header = TRUE, row.names = 1)

design.irr <- subset(design, Irrigation == "irrigated")
design.unirr <- subset(design, Irrigation == "non-irrigated")

# 2. Select the same number of samples at random as there are non-irrigated samples.
set.seed(12345)
nonirr.samples <- sample(rownames(design.unirr), size = 23, replace = FALSE)

# 3. Taxonomic Community 
comm <- read.csv("./Homogenization_analysis/Data/RPKM.KO.abundance_9353.csv", header = TRUE, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)

# 4. Sample selection
# 46 samples
selected.samples <- c(rownames(design.irr),  nonirr.samples)

stopifnot(all(selected.samples %in% colnames(comm)))

comm.new01 <- comm[ , selected.samples, drop = FALSE]

# Filter low-abundance features
comm.new01 <- comm.new01[rowSums(comm.new01) > 10,  ,  drop = FALSE]

# Samples × features
comm.new <- t(comm.new01)

design.new <- design[rownames(comm.new), , drop = FALSE]

design.new$Irrigation <- factor(design.new$Irrigation, levels = c("non-irrigated", "irrigated"))

stopifnot(all(rowSums(comm.new) > 0))

# 5. Calculate dissimilarity
jac_dist <- vegdist(comm.new,  method = "jaccard",  binary = T) # ignore abundance, consider presence

# 6. Convert to similarity
jac_sim <- 1 - as.matrix(jac_dist)

# 7. Function: within-group similarity
calculate_similarity <- function(sim_matrix, metadata) {
  
  groups <- metadata$Irrigation
  results <- list()
  for (g in levels(groups)) {
    samples <- rownames(metadata)[groups == g]
    submat <- sim_matrix[
      samples,
      samples,
      drop = FALSE
    ]
    
    values <- submat[lower.tri(submat)]
    results[[g]] <- data.frame(
      Irrigation = g,
      Similarity = values
    )
  }
  
  bind_rows(results)
}

# 8. Calculate within-group similarities
jac_data <- calculate_similarity(jac_sim, design.new)

# 9. Summarize
jac_summary <- jac_data %>%
  group_by(Irrigation) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(Similarity),
    SD = sd(Similarity),
    N_pairs = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(jac_summary)


# 10. Relative change in similarity (%)
relative_change <- function(df) {
  irr <- df$Mean[df$Irrigation == "irrigated"]
  unirr <- df$Mean[df$Irrigation == "non-irrigated"]
  (irr - unirr) / unirr * 100
}

relative_change(jac_summary)
```
